title: Central Limit Theorems for Persistent Betti Numbers
summary: Various persistent invariants have been developed in recent years. In this paper, we develop a method based on homological algebra for deriving central limit theorems for persistent Betti numbers associated with $\mathbb{R}$-indexed chain complexes constructed from a homogeneous Poisson point process of unit intensity on $\mathbb{R}^d$. Our method also applies to Gibbs point processes. This algebraic method reduces the verification of the required conditions to checking properties of the kernels and cokernels of add one maps between chain complexes.
